DT.Categories.AbilityScoreProminence.Hin: Display tweaks for ability scores on dnd5e actor sheets. Per-user.
DT.Settings.AbilitySwapScoreAndMod.Name: Show Ability Score Large
DT.Settings.AbilitySwapScoreAndMod.Hint: Moves the score directly under the ability name and shows it large; the modifier moves below it and is shown small.
DT.Settings.AbilityExpandedRollTargets.H: Lets you click the ability score or modifier (not just the ability name) to roll an ability check.
DT.Categories.Pause.Label: Pause
DT.Categories.Pause.Hint: Game pause behaviour. World-level (set by the GM).
DT.Settings.UnpauseOnWorldLoad.Name: Unpause When World Loads
DT.Settings.UnpauseOnWorldLoad.Hint: Worlds normally start paused. When enabled, the first client to connect (GM or player) automatically unpauses the game. Applies on the next world load / server start. Note: also unpauses if anyone reloads the page while the game is intentionally paused.
